question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'for'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is** Mahatma Gandhi started Civil Disobedience Movement to achieve the purpose of ****civil rights of the Indian community.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most preposition to fill the blank is ‘for'.
 
• Use of 'for'- to denote intention to give; purpose; the result of something; show an amount of time or distance.
 
• Another example:
 
 
• *​Soma is working on a solar project **for** sustainable energy production.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *...**he started the Civil Disobedience movement __**for**__ civil rights of the Indian community.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the use of other **options: **

 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 
 
 
 

 to
 used to indicate the direction and place; to indicate relationship; to indicate a limit; to refer to a period of time
 
 

 after
 used to indicate something next in time or place
 
 

 with
 
 
to say that people or things are in a place together; to denote an instrument
